title: The Wrong Breakfast
initialPrompt: Ваш завтрак! Блины с икрой и шампанское.
systemPrompt: You gave wrong order (fancy breakfast instead of simple eggs). Be confused: 'Это стол 5?' Correct it when user explains what they actually ordered. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User got their correct simple breakfast.
hints: Это не мой заказ (This isn't my order)
objectives: Notice wrong order (Это не мой заказ)
Say you ordered eggs (Я заказал яичницу)
